mapper.insert: /** mainbanner-mapper.insertMainBanner (메인 배너 등록) */ INSERT INTO OP_MAIN_BANNER ( BANNER_ID, TITLE, CONTENTS, LINK_URL, DISPLAY_ORDER, CREATED_DATE, PC_FILE_NAME, M_FILE_NAME, PC_ORG_FILE_NAME, M_ORG_FILE_NAME, DISPLAY_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{bannerId}, #{title}, #{linkUrl}, #{contents}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(DISPLAY_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM OP_MAIN_BANNER), , #{pcFileName}, #{mFileName}, #{pcOrgFileName}, #{mOrgFileName}, #{displayFlag} )
mapper.select: /** mainbanner-mapper.getMainBannerDetails (메인 배너 상세) */ SELECT MB.BANNER_ID, MB.TITLE, MB.CONTENTS, MB.LINK_URL, MB.DISPLAY_ORDER, MB.CREATED_DATE, MB.PC_FILE_NAME, MB.M_FILE_NAME, MB.PC_ORG_FILE_NAME, MB.M_ORG_FILE_NAME, MB.DISPLAY_FLAG FROM OP_MAIN_BANNER MB WHERE MB.BANNER_ID = #{bannerId}
mapper.update: /** mainbanner-mapper.updateMainBanner (메인 배너 수정) */ UPDATE OP_MAIN_BANNER SET TITLE = #{title}, LINK_URL = #{linkUrl}, CONTENTS = #{contents}, PC_FILE_NAME = #{pcFileName}, PC_ORG_FILE_NAME = #{pcOrgFileName}, M_FILE_NAME = #{mFileName}, M_ORG_FILE_NAME = #{mOrgFileName}, DISPLAY_FLAG = #{displayFlag} WHERE BANNER_ID = #{bannerId}
